verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is compute infrastructure for running untrusted or agent code. A platform like this could plausibly offer built-in AI insights, for example on logs or usage, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only building blocks: an example of a user-built LLM coding agent and log-fetching APIs. There is no first-party feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's data inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
